platform: Cloud-based web SaaS ERP with claimed Android and iOS mobile apps; no current on-premise deployment documented.

distinctive_features.feature: Accreditation Data Management for NAAC, NBA and NIRF reporting, with evidence uploads and audit trails.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: It supports Indian higher-education institutions in organizing accreditation evidence and producing review-ready reports.

distinctive_features.feature: OBE capabilities map course outcomes to program outcomes and support attainment calculations.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: The mapping connects assessment results to outcome-based education reporting and institutional review.

distinctive_features.feature: CBCS and NEP-aligned course selection includes prerequisites, electives and credit-load checks.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: These controls help institutions manage complex credit choices and registration rules.

distinctive_features.feature: Examination workflows include configurable grading, online proctoring signals and QR-verified credentials.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: It supports examination administration, result verification and credential integrity.

distinctive_features.feature: Affiliated-college and multi-campus operations connect institution-level data with central reporting.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Groups can coordinate administration and reporting across campuses or affiliated institutions.

distinctive_features.feature: Alumni capabilities include mentoring, jobs, chapters, donations, pledges and e-voting.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Institutions can manage alumni engagement and fundraising within the education platform.

distinctive_features.feature: Attendance supports biometric, RFID, QR, OTP, mobile and geolocation methods.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Institutions can use multiple attendance methods across classrooms, hostels and staff workflows.

distinctive_features.feature: Vendor-claimed AI Copilot and agents cover search, advising and selected administrative checks.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: If available as claimed, these tools could assist users across academic and administrative workflows.

weaknesses.issue: Pricing is quote-only, and plan boundaries and implementation costs are not publicly specified.
G2 reviewers report refreshes, app freezing and attendance glitches.
G2 feedback cites weaker mobile compatibility and requests a more advanced mobile app.
Gartner’s public summary reports cross-integration challenges between modules.
Public documentation lacks an API reference, named payment connectors and a public SLA.
Institution and user adoption figures conflict across vendor pages and are not independently audited.

ai_features: Vendor-claimed MS AI Copilot and AI Agents.
Claimed dropout prediction and at-risk-student identification.
Claimed AI assistance for fee configuration, scholarship and document checks, payroll validation, and query management.
Model providers and feature-tier availability are not publicly documented.
pricing_model_summary: No public MasterSoft pricing page or plan table. Pricing is quote-only; the stated ₹0–₹250 per student yearly range is general market guidance, not a MasterSoft quote.
biggest_strategic_gap: Public evidence does not establish a documented integration ecosystem: no API reference, marketplace, or verified OneRoster, LTI or Ed-Fi support.
